China: Leadership, May 2Zhu De, leaving Xi’an eastward and passing the Huashan, writes two poems, “Huashan” 《华山》: the mountain standing by the Yellow River, looking east to the Hangu Pass; the steepest under heaven, but no height that cannot be climbed.Zhu De nianpu (xinbian ben), 1886–1976, III, 1874–1875. June 1963

Thursday, June 13
  1. China: Four Cleanups, June 13Xi’an, Shaanxi. Peng Zhen with Liu Lantao, Zhang Desheng and others on output and the “four clean-ups” in the northwest: Mao has said no one in China survives who does not get on with the peasants; two 95 percents united; striking too many cadres looks “left” but is right, it helps the enemy; of the other 5 percent, the diehards isolated, the middle won; a man set on going it alone struggled with and united with.Peng Zhen nianpu, 1902–1997 彭真年谱（1902—1997） [Chronological biography of Peng Zhen, 1902–1997], 5 vols., IV, 277 (‘Peng Zhen zhuan’ Bianxiezu 《彭真传》编写组 ed., 2012). Made public: 2012. See May 15–June 14. Names: Peng Zhen 彭真, Mao Zedong 毛泽东, Liu Lantao, Zhang Desheng.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Friday, June 14
  1. China: Four Cleanups, June 14Xi’an. Peng Zhen reports to the cadres of the Northwest Bureau and the Shaanxi committee: socialist education the greatest revolutionary movement since land reform, digging up revisionism’s roots; in the hard years some doubted the collective, sought free trade, speculated, wanted capitalism, many old guerrillas “new soldiers” before the socialist revolution; men to be re-educated, the revolutionary ranks regrouped; the masses roused, 20 percent of teams with grave problems, leadership seized; the upper-middle peasants friends, “仅仅是搞单干的，不能打击,” for no law forbids it, only competition; cadres of landlord, rich peasant and bourgeois birth examined and taught patiently; erring cadres allowed and welcomed to correct; a “middle zone” of 4 or 5 percent to be won.Peng Zhen nianpu, 1902–1997, IV, 277–278. Made public: 2012. See May 15–June 14. Names: Peng Zhen.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Sunday, June 16
  1. China: Propaganda and culture, June 16Shaanxi: plays inspired by the West performed in the cities, feudal opera reviving in the countryside; tutors in private schools of the Wei River valley return to the Confucian classics; in Xi’an counter-revolutionary publications, some following Hu Feng, some praising Chiang Kai-shek, openly on sale at bookstalls; units order reading from abroad, the Xi’an Foreign Language Institute subscribing to scores of foreign papers; at Hanzhong University the first English lesson is “The United States’ Today is Our Tomorrow.”Frank Dikötter, The Cultural Revolution: A People’s History, 1962–1976, at 30–31 n.9 (2016). Made public: 2016. To check: Report from the Shaanxi Office for Propaganda, June 16, 1963, Shandong Provincial Archives, A1-2-1153, pp. 74–88 (cited by Dikötter, Cultural Revolution, 31 n.9b). Names: Chiang Kai-shek 蒋介石.⟨⟨ China: Propaganda and culture ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

1964

April 1964

Tuesday, Apr. 14
  1. China: Propaganda and culture: Lei Feng, Dazhai, Daqing · China: Four Cleanups, Apr. 14–16Xi’an. Peng Zhen inspects (to Apr. 16); the Xi’an committee tells of too many meetings and side tasks hurting the “five antis,” the masses weary, and in learning from Daqing and the PLA haste, too little sleep, “high-yield days,” “Saturday battles,” commandism; to the Shaanxi committee’s heads: two attitudes to the three years’ leap, denial or “one divides into two”; some do no solid work but loud show, formalism, long, empty meetings, impossible forms, overtime, spending the masses’ zeal; the central ministries to go to the front, needless meetings, papers and forms dropped, no boasting in the press, overtime stopped, visits cut, no “touring” inspections; the masses’ zeal not doused but cherished.Peng Zhen nianpu, 1902–1997, IV, 327–328. Made public: 2012. See Apr. 7–12. Names: Peng Zhen.⟨⟨ China: Propaganda and culture: Lei Feng, Dazhai, Daqing ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Propaganda and culture ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩□

  1. China: Four Cleanups, Jan.Shaanxi. By the Northwest Bureau’s later material: at the committee’s January meeting Hu Yaobang attacks the socialist education movement: too many dead, too many arrested, the struggle too wide, the poor and lower-middle peasants hurt; the training of erring cadres “isolation everywhere.” Zhao Shouyi adds to it; around the meeting the two put out a series of “suspensions.”Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 135.   2. China: Four Cleanups, Mar. 28Xi’an. Liu Lantao opens the sixteen-county meeting (Yang Shangkun’s notes): to sum up the work since the Twenty-three Articles, all differences to be aired, the Northwest Bureau’s included; the chief aim to make policy one, not county by county; besides a summary, papers on clearing classes (Yang Jingren) and on restitution (Li Dengying), short and plain.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 532 (Mar. 28, 1965). The words: 刘澜涛: 西北五省十六个重点县的会议 (II, 532). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Liu Lantao, Yang Shangkun, Yang Jingren 杨静仁, Li Dengying.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
  3. China: Four Cleanups · China: Organization, Mar. 28Xi’an. Wang Zhao reports on Qinghai (Yang Shangkun’s notes): 8,040 cadres in most of Huangzhong county, some 270,000 people, since late October; over 60 percent of the poor and lower-middle peasants in the association; the economic cleanup nearly done, 90 percent of cadres cleared or freed; grain recovered 9.66 million jin, 6.1 million returned; cash 3.52 million yuan, 1.94 million returned; over a hundred guns; 130 group cases; the movement to end in late May. In the county’s 377 units, about 26 percent not in “our” hands; Party members to be purged perhaps 25 percent; branch secretaries 60 percent unfit; the democratic revolution’s lessons to be made up, a ninth of the area (160,000 people) never had land reform; Ma Bufang’s 800 cadres, two executed; a few with blood debts to be executed late in the movement.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 532–536 (Mar. 28, 1965). The words: 王昭: (一) 青海共8040干部，在湟中县的大部分地区……中进行 (II, 532). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Wang Zhao, Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Organization ⟩⟩□
  4. China: Four Cleanups · China: Agriculture, Mar. 28Xi’an. Li Youjiu reports on Gansu (Yang Shangkun’s notes): five farming counties of Zhangye, five townships of the Gannan pastures, part of Lanzhou’s outskirts; 26,000 in the teams; 21 percent of cadres struggled against in the “small battle”; 90.7 percent of 37,000 cadres freed; grain uncovered 32 million jin, 14 million returned; cash 9.7 million yuan, 3.07 million returned; capitalist-roaders 873 in the villages (2.31 percent), 94 in the cities; of five county committees three fairly good, Shandan and Gaotai with more problems. Unfinished.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 536–538 (Mar. 28, 1965). The words: 李友九: 张掖5个农业县，甘南牧区5个乡，兰州近郊一部分 (II, 536). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Li Youjiu, Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Agriculture ⟩⟩□

  1. China: Four Cleanups, Mar. 29Xi’an · 9 a.m.Xi’an. The sixteen-county meeting, 9 a.m. to noon and 3 to 6 p.m.: Li Youjiu ends his report on Gansu (Yang Shangkun’s notes): capitalist-roaders to be capped 534 (1.7 percent), to be held to 1 percent; landlords and rich peasants 6.2 percent drawn, 2.9 more found; their children, the province leans, to be called “peasants of landlord or rich-peasant origin”; restitution reaching 70 percent of cadres; of 45 county standing committee members 25 kept; of 322 commune secretaries and heads 94 removed; Party members expelled or persuaded out 17 percent; Hexi’s grain to reach 2 billion jin. Yang there.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 538–540 (Mar. 29, 1965). The words: 上午9时到12时，下午3时到6时，继续开会，听完了李友九的汇报后 (II, 538). The time is the first session’s. Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). See Mar. 28. Names: Li Youjiu, Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

  3. China: Four Cleanups, Mar. 29Xi’an. Qi Guo reports on Xinjiang (Yang Shangkun’s notes): 23 percent of the people (1.67 million, 211 of 702 communes) through the movement before last July; since the Center’s May meeting twelve points, six counties among them, some 570,000 people, 24,325 cadres; 10,520 of 15,510 cadres “released”; 3.814 million yuan uncovered, 119,000 returned; cadres good 26 percent, fairly good 37, many problems 27, serious 10; local nationalists and those in league with foreign countries; 131 fled; the four cleanups to end by April 10 to May 10, the movement by end of June; landlords and rich peasants over 10 percent with those missed.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 540–543 (Mar. 29, 1965). The words: 祁果: 工作进展较慢，已有报告了 (II, 540). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Qi Guo, Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

China: Finance and economy: Third Front · China: Four Cleanups, Apr. 14Xi’an · 9 a.m.Xi’an, 9 a.m. to noon and 3 to 6 p.m. Wang Lin reports to Zhu De on the socialist education, industry, agriculture and the third front, Liu Lantao there in the morning; Yang Shangkun there. Wang: the five northwestern provinces’ grain 24 billion jin at most (1957), 16.7 billion in 1961, 22.9 billion in 1964, not self-sufficient (Shaanxi to bring in 300 million jin this year); industrial output 4 billion yuan in 1962, 5.1 billion in 1964 (up 18.3 percent), 1.4 billion in this year’s first quarter (up 35 percent); the Baiyin works 30,000 tons of copper this year; capital construction 460 million yuan in 1962, 1.54 billion in 1964, 2.3 billion in 1965; 1,000 km of railway in the first five-year plan, over 2,000 in the second, 2,000 more to come, seven lines; Liujiaxia under way.Zhu De nianpu (xinbian ben), 1886–1976, III, 1930 (Apr. 14, 1965; Zhu De 朱德 hears Wang Lin 王林, alternate secretary of the Center’s Northwest Bureau 中共中央西北局, on industry and farming); Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 583–584 (Apr. 14, 1965). The words: 上午9时到12时(澜涛同志上午参加，下午进村去了)，下午3时到6时，由王林同志汇报社教、工业、农业、三线的情况 (II, 583). The time is the first session’s. Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Wang Lin, Zhu De, Liu Lantao, Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy: Third Front ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩□

May 1965

Sunday, May 9
  1. China: Four Cleanups, May 9Doumen · 10:30 a.m.Doumen, the textile mill, 10:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. Yang Shangkun, having walked to the Doumen middle school for a photograph with the Party members and cadres squatting in the area, reports to over 800 of them: the war in Vietnam; opposing revisionism; the chief gains of the socialist education. There: Li Dengying, Li Qiyang, Yan Kelun, Gao Buting, deputy head of the corps (the editors’ note), Zhang Jingwen of the Xianyang prefectural committee, Hu Qiang.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 597 (May 9, 1965). The words: 10时半开始向800多蹲点党员干部作报告……讲了两个半小时，到1点才散 (II, 597). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Yang Shangkun, Li Dengying, Li Qiyang, Yan Kelun, Gao Buting 高步亭, Zhang Jingwen 张景文, Hu Qiang.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

Tuesday, May 18
  1. China: Leadership, May 18Huashan · 8:30 a.m.Huashan. Yang Shangkun climbs from the Yuquan Temple at 8:30 a.m.: by the Wulong Palace and the first pass to Shaluoping, ten li; on to Qingkeping, ten li more, in rain; after lunch and an hour’s sleep, up the Qianchichuang, the Baichixia and the Laojun Furrow to the North Peak (Yuntai Peak), where he spends the night: thirty li in the day.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 606 (May 18, 1965). The words: 在车上吃早饭后，单车前进到玉泉院下车，8时半开始上山……今天共走30华里 (II, 606). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Leadership ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Wednesday, May 19
  1. China: Leadership, May 19Huashan · morningHuashan. Yang Shangkun walks from the North Peak by the Canglong Ridge to the West Peak (its weather station), the South Peak, the highest, for lunch, and the Middle Peak; back on the North Peak after 5 p.m.: some thirty li, every peak but the East.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 606–607 (May 19, 1965). The words: 早饭后，由北峰出发……回到北峰已经是下午5时多了……今天共走约30华里 (II, 606). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). Names: Yang Shangkun.⟨⟨ China: Leadership ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

  1. China: Leadership, May 25Xi’an · 11 a.m.Yang Shangkun, with Li Bozhao and Hu Sheng, flown that morning from Zhengzhou, flies from Xi’an at 11 a.m. and reaches Yan’an at noon, his first return since he left in March 1947; met by Han Yiping, the prefectural secretary (the editors’ note), Tu Jinzhang and others; lodging at the old reception office.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 609 (May 25, 1965). The words: 上午10时伯钊、胡绳同志都由飞机从郑州接来西安。11时一齐起飞去延安，飞行共1小时，12时到达 (II, 609). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.).   2. China: Center’s daily work, May 25Yan’an · 3 p.m.Yan’an, from 3 p.m. to 8. Yang Shangkun visits the Zaoyuan, the Yanyuan, the lodgings of Mao, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De and Ren Bishi, the small auditorium, Yangjialing and Wangjiaping, telling of the history as he goes. By the provincial committee’s record of his talks of the 25th and 26th (the editors’ note): the Center’s thirteen years in north Shaanxi in three stages (to the Eastern Expedition’s return, May 1936; the westward expansion to the Xi’an Incident; Yan’an); Wayaobu, Bao’an and Yan’an its centers; who lived where at each site, the Central Auditorium, the Seventh Congress; corrections to the exhibits’ labels.Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 609–621 (May 25, 1965). The words: 下午3时乘车经清凉山大桥……直到枣园。参观了枣园、延园……回到招待所已经8时了 (II, 609). Made public: 2001 (Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, 2 vols.). To check: the Shaanxi provincial Party committee’s record of Yang Shangkun’s talks at Yan’an, May 25–26, 1965 (cited by Yang Shangkun, Yang Shangkun riji, II, 609 n.2). Names: Yang Shangkun, Mao Zedong, Liu Shaoqi 刘少奇, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Ren Bishi 任弼时.⟨⟨ China: Center’s daily work ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

March 1966

March
  1. China: Four Cleanups, Mar.The Shaanxi committee’s fourth plenum of its fourth term adopts “Views on the summary of the work of recent years and the main tasks ahead” and a “Resolution on several questions of the socialist education movement”: the Four Cleanups in town and country to be finished in about three years, settling in them the incomplete land reform, the incomplete suppression of counter-revolutionaries and the impure organizations, and completing the “make-up lessons of the democratic revolution”.Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 133. Made public: 2008.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩Estimates. Bu Weihua puts at over 60,000 the working households across the province misclassified as landlords and rich peasants in the “make-up lessons” (Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 133).□
Wednesday, Mar. 9
  1. China: Finance and economy: Third Front, Mar. 9Deng Xiaoping, with Li Fuchun, Bo Yibo and others, leaves Peking by special plane for Xi’an, to inspect third-front construction in the Northwest.Deng Xiaoping nianpu, 1904–1974, III, 1899 (Mar. 9, 1966). Made public: 2009 (the nianpu). Names: Deng Xiaoping, Li Fuchun 李富春, Bo Yibo 薄一波.⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy: Third Front ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Thursday, Mar. 10
  1. China: Finance and economy: Third Front, Mar. 10Xi’an · morningDeng Xiaoping hears Liu Lantao and Wang Lin on the work of the Central Committee’s Northwest Bureau. Deng: the Northwest must have machine-tool capacity on the third front; arsenals are to specialize, make some machine parts and some civilian things; on soil and water conservation: the film of the Gaoxigou in Mizhi county, with terraces and dam fields, is the way, ditch by ditch, a hundred years of tree planting on the loess plateau; the grain base is the whole country’s base and must send out commodity grain; the Sanmenxia reservoir has pushed the water up, turning harm to good, and with more groundwater terraced fields can be made; the Northwest need not send out grain but must raise reserves by 500 million jin a year for war, both in state granaries and in the hands of production teams; the key to the country’s farm problems is the North.Deng Xiaoping nianpu, 1904–1974, III, 1899 (Mar. 10, 1966). The words: 上午 (III, 1899). Made public: 2009 (the nianpu). Names: Deng Xiaoping, Liu Lantao, Wang Lin.⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy: Third Front ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Finance and economy ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
  2. China: Four Cleanups, Mar. 10Xi’an · afternoonDeng Xiaoping hears the Shaanxi provincial Party committee. When told that the landlords and rich peasants newly classed in the socialist education movement equal those of land reform, he says: those who for ten-odd years have worked honestly, accepted remolding and made no trouble need not again wear the cap; this policy must be shown, a very important policy. On industry: it is a question of matching sets; more small industry, a question of direction; go the way of specialization and cooperation, more economical; city surplus labor to be organized, all taking part in labor, so that petty theft and trouble at the city people’s committee fall off and the big plants’ output can multiply, the whole country to go this way. On the ‘four clean-ups’: work with cadres who erred, encourage them, divide in two, say they are bad now, were good, have forgotten their root and may recall it, those who mend after a time may be elected again; the Twenty-three Articles have strict limits, restitution reasonable, the share of cadres dealt with not large, one, two, three, four percent, the blow not wide, so that after the work teams leave grass-roots cadres, new and old, can unite to work.Deng Xiaoping nianpu, 1904–1974, III, 1899–1900 (Mar. 10, 1966). The words: 下午 (III, 1899–1900). Made public: 2009 (the nianpu). Names: Deng Xiaoping.⟨⟨ China: Four Cleanups ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

June 1966

Wednesday, June 1
  1. China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams, June 1Xi’an. The Northwest Bureau opens its enlarged third plenum (to July 11), later widened to the leaders of the five northwestern provinces and regions down to the county secretaries. Barred from naming Hu Yaobang, a cadre under the Center, it calls openly for exposing the “black line of Peng (Dehuai) 彭德怀, Gao (Gang) 高岗 and Xi (Zhongxun) 习仲勋 in the Northwest,” with Zhao Shouyi and Li Qiming as their agents and Hu as head: the Northwest “Three-Family Village.”Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 134. Made public: 2008. Names: Peng Dehuai, Hu Yaobang, Zhao Shouyi, Li Qiming.⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□

Monday, June 6
  1. China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams · China: Propaganda and culture, June 6Xi’an Jiaotong University, the “June 6 incident”. Students begin to drive out the work group; Li Shiying, of class 801-41, calls in a poster to “dig out the black line in the provincial committee and the Northwest Bureau”; the work group’s members are surrounded, Yan Kelun by six or seven hundred; dozens of students go to the Bureau, the provincial committee, the Xinhua branch and the Shaanxi ribao and post at the telegraph building. The Bureau’s general office tells them the Bureau represents the Center, the provincial committee is correct, its work group revolutionary.Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 157, 157 n.103. To check: Song Qiong 宋瓊 and Zhang Wenrong 張文榮, 〈6月2日以來西安交大運動發展的概況〉 (June 21, 1966) (cited by Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 157 n.103).   2. China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams, June 6, eveningXi’an · eveningXi’an Jiaotong University. The work group meets and finds that a batch of trouble-making “sharp ones” and ox-demons and snake-spirits has come out, in every class; it will organize to trace them to their roots.Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 157, 157 n.103. The words: 當天晚上 (157). Made public: 2008. To check: Song Qiong 宋瓊 and Zhang Wenrong 張文榮, 〈6月2日以來西安交大運動發展的概況〉 (June 21, 1966) (cited by Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 157 n.103).⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Tuesday, June 7
  1. China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams, June 7–9Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an. After Li Shiying posts “Ten Crimes of the Work Group” on June 6, the work group fixes the “June 6 incident” as counter-revolutionary and holds struggle meetings against him three days running. He swallows a mass of sleeping pills and is saved at hospital; the group holds back his note and says that “with 700 million people, one dead is nothing.”Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 157 (June 7, 8 and 9, the departments hold struggle meetings large and small against the “sharp ones,” Li Shiying and others paraded in tall hats; at noon on the 9th Li tries to kill himself and fails; Mao later calls him a “student leader”; the reporters’ account (157 n.103)); Dikötter, Cultural Revolution, 65 n.31 (after a schoolmate is condemned as a rightist for calling the president a “capitalist roader,” students hunger-strike three days opposite the provincial Party headquarters; students of other universities join; Zhou Enlai intervenes); Yang Jisheng, Tiandi fanfu, I, 211. Made public: 2016. See June 3.⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩□
Monday, June 13
  1. China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams · China: Propaganda and culture, June 13The Northwest Bureau has a culture and education secretary of the Shaanxi committee open a “Cultural Revolution forum” (to Sept. 18), later renamed a “cadres’ training class”, to drag out and struggle members of the “Hu–Zhao–Li Three-Family Village anti-Party clique”: its forty-odd targets, kept without freedom, are the committee’s secretary-general and deputies, deputy heads of its general office, propaganda and rural work departments, prefectural secretaries, middle cadres of the Bureau and the Xi’an committee, and others.Bu Weihua, Zalan jiu shijie, 134. Made public: 2008. See June 1.⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution: May Sixteenth and the work teams ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Cultural Revolution ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China ⟩⟩⟨⟨ China: Propaganda and culture ⟩⟩□

  1. China: Cultural Revolution: Red Guards, Sept. 20Xi’an. The “Red Terror Team” 紅色恐怖隊, mostly high cadres’ children, is founded on the model of Peking’s West City Pickets and in close touch with them; its members beat people, search homes and drive the families of the “four kinds” to the countryside, and later send men to Peking to join the United Action Committee’s storming of the Ministry of Public Security.Yang Jisheng, Tiandi fanfu, I, 271. Saturday, Jan. 13
  1.
